objective: Relay Rounds v0.1: pure match rules (teams, baton, ranking, disconnects) with Lune tests, a server that runs lobby, course and rounds, and a second Rojo project that builds the place.
acceptance_criteria: Team sizes differ by at most 1 for 4 to 16 players (RelayRules unit test)
Ranking follows GDD section D including ties (RelayRules unit test)
A pass happens only in the handoff zone to a teammate who has not run (RelayRules unit test)
Every disconnect case in GDD section E leaves a valid match state (RelayRules unit tests)
A course never has fewer than 2 legs (RelayRules unit test)
A 4-player staging playtest completes a match with a winner
verification: Lune tests in CI, QA review of the server script, then a 4-player staging playtest
evidence: Local run on 2026-10-24: lune run tests/run 64/64 passed; rojo build of both projects OK; validate-tasks OK.
notes: No saves, remotes or economy, so no decision record needed. Shortcut: the relay place also ships the Bake Rush shared modules (unused) because both projects map src/shared; split per game if a third game arrives. Needs its own staging experience and a publish.yml project input before it can be published.
